details.description: Left cranial contour narrows toward the cheek; pale sclera and amber edge of the left eye enter the crop.
details.affects: preserve round head contour and visible eye/sclera overlap

details.description: Two warm charcoal tones meet at the sloping crown silhouette; a tuft socket overlaps the head mass with a soft warm rim.
details.affects: retain soft soot-like surface and visible crown attachment

details.description: Smaller rear crown tuft ends in a curved leaf/flame tip with a warm cream fill and ochre outline.
details.affects: keep the secondary tuft tapered, smaller, and curved

details.description: Raised short arm bends toward the cheek and overlaps the side of the body; part of the opposite eye is visible.
details.affects: make the raised arm read as attached and keep a cute compact pose

details.description: Large amber iris has a dark pupil, orange radial variation, pale sclera, and a high-value catchlight; curved brow and small smile sit above a folded teal scarf band.
details.affects: preserve oversized eye scale and friendly face; boost scarf hue/value contrast against charcoal body

details.description: Head outline remains organic at the lateral cheek; scarf tail emerges behind the torso with a frayed tapered silhouette.
details.affects: separate body contour from scarf tail; do not model edge fraying as holes

details.description: Lower body tapers into a small rounded foot; the other foot is partially visible at the edge.
details.affects: keep feet small relative to the body and ground both feet

details.description: Round charcoal torso has warm mottled painterly patches; short opposite arm overlaps the torso near the scarf.
details.affects: use subtle broad albedo/roughness variation without noisy micro-texture

details.description: Two scarf tails overlap and curve downward; teal base is visibly lighter than the shadowed underside, with warm gold flecks and broad fold lines.
details.affects: make scarf brighter and more saturated teal than the body, with readable layered folds and two distinct ends

authoringInstruction: Every visible identity feature maps to a real component.localFeatures or material.localOverrides entry in the sculpt spec.
